blind.description: A wooden coat rack or robe stand consisting of two vertical posts on wide foot supports, connected by a top bar with hanging pegs and a low stretcher. Hanging from the pegs are five identical hooded monk robes tied with rope belts. The geometry is solid, continuous, and cleanly modeled with stylized hand-painted textures of dark brown wood, olive-brown cloth, and tan rope cords.
blind.from_above: A straight horizontal wooden bar with square decorative endcaps, projecting peg dowels, rounded tops of hanging hoods, and two perpendicular stabilizing feet at either end.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 4.5 to 5 feet tall (standing roughly shoulder-high to the 5 ft 9 in figure) and about 4.5 feet wide.
